body.segment: Novel double-shelled CoMn2O4 hollow microcubes with nanometer-sized building blocks have been prepared by a facile co-precipitation and annealing method.

In virtue of the unique structural features, the resultant CoMn2O4 hollow structures exhibit high specific capacity (~830 mA h g-1 at 200 mA g-1) and good cycling performance as an anode material for lithium-ion batteries.
